pass_alias_column.definition: SELECT a.id AS id FROM accounts a

pass_partial.definition: SELECT id, COALESCE(token, id) AS other FROM accounts

multiple_statements.definition: SELECT id FROM accounts; SELECT id FROM accounts

cte_definition.definition: WITH a AS (SELECT id FROM accounts) SELECT id FROM a

union_definition.definition: SELECT id FROM accounts UNION SELECT id FROM accounts

multiple_from.definition: SELECT a.id FROM accounts a, orders o

joined_definition.definition: SELECT a.id FROM accounts a JOIN orders o ON o.account_id = a.id

derived_definition.definition: SELECT a.id FROM (SELECT id FROM accounts) a

renamed_base_columns.definition: SELECT a.id FROM accounts a(id, renamed_email, renamed_token)

duplicate_alias.definition: SELECT id AS key, token AS key FROM accounts

duplicate_computed.definition: SELECT id, COALESCE(token, id) AS id FROM accounts

duplicate_computed_first.definition: SELECT COALESCE(token, id) AS id, id FROM accounts

duplicate_qualified_star.definition: SELECT a.*, a.* FROM accounts a

duplicate_star_after_computed.definition: SELECT COALESCE(token, id) AS id, * FROM accounts

missing_column.definition: SELECT missing AS id FROM accounts

computed_column.definition: SELECT COALESCE(token, id) AS id FROM accounts

modified_replace.definition: SELECT * REPLACE (token AS id) FROM accounts

modified_rename.definition: SELECT * RENAME (token AS id) FROM accounts

modified_alias.definition: SELECT * AS (id, email, token, custom, array) FROM accounts
